scope: Clearer web page labels, easier link lists, and a choice about HTTP pages.

topics.title: Choose whether to block HTTP pages
details: Block nonsecure HTTP pages is a new Web browser option. It is off by default. HTTP links can open and can be saved as favorites. Turn the setting on to block HTTP pages and redirects to HTTP.

topics.title: Move between frames
details: Press M or Shift+M, or say "Next frame" or "Previous frame". Frame names and readable content appear in page order. Hidden frames are skipped.

topics.title: Hear clearer page labels
details: Companion uses the names supplied by the website. It identifies graphics, lists, list items, and page regions. Missing names are reported as missing.
K and Shift+K move between links. L and Shift+L move between lists. I and Shift+I move between list items. G moves to a graphic. D moves to a region. Hold Shift to move backward.

topics.title: Find a link by name
details: In the links list, type a first letter, several letters, or the full link name. Spaces and Backspace work too. Typing selects a match; Enter opens it. The headings list supports the same name search.
